$comment: ACCEPTED bytecode drift: deployed addresses whose on-chain runtime code (immutables masked) is NOT reproduced by a clean build of this tree. Every entry needs a reason, because an exemption without one is not a decision. Enforced BOTH ways by bytecode_audit.py --baseline: an un-listed STALE address fails, AND a listed address that has become CURRENT fails so the file cannot rot into a rubber stamp. Delete an entry the moment its address is redeployed - do not leave it 'just in case', because it would then silently accept a FUTURE drift at that address.
$howToAdd: Run `forge clean && forge build` then `python3 script/deploy/preflight/bytecode_audit.py <chainId>`. Anything reported [STALE] is either something to redeploy or something to declare here. Prefer redeploying.
